nodes.summary: Fix a natural number $l \ge 3$. There are only finitely many perfect $l$-th powers $y = x^l$ ($x \in \mathbb{N}$) whose decimal digits are all equal but one, that is, some digit $c$ occurs in the decimal representation of $y$ and exactly one digit position of $y$ holds a digit other than $c$, apart from the powers $10^{ln}$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) and, when $l = 3$, the cubes $8 \cdot 10^{3n}$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$).
nodes.title: Perfect powers with all decimal digits equal but one (Kihel–Luca)
Palindromic representations of powers of two

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $b$ and $n$ with $b \ge 2$, write $n = \sum_{i\lt k} d_i b^i$ with digits $0 \le d_i < b$ and leading digit $d_{k-1} \ne 0$ (so $k = 0$ when $n = 0$). The base-$b$ reversal of $n$ is the natural number $\sum_{i\lt k} d_{k-1-i} b^i$. For the bases $b = 0$ and $b = 1$ the reversal of $n$ is $n$ itself.
nodes.title: Digit reversal

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a perfect square whose decimal representation, read from the most significant digit, consists of $r \ge 1$ copies of a digit $a$ with $1 \le a \le 9$ followed by $s \ge 1$ copies of a digit $b$ with $0 \le b \le 9$. Then $n$ is one of $16$, $25$, $36$, $49$, $64$, $81$, $144$, $225$, $441$, $1444$ and $7744$, or there is a natural number $i$ such that $n = 10^{2i}$, $n = 4 \cdot 10^{2i}$ or…
nodes.title: Squares with two blocks of repeated digits

nodes.summary: The positive triangular numbers $n(n+1)/2$ with $n \ge 1$ whose decimal representation consists of a single repeated digit are exactly $1$, $3$, $6$, $55$, $66$ and $666$.
nodes.title: Triangular repdigits

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
